title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
summary: The briefing incorrectly describes the entire Package Management API as preview, although the connection-review call has a documented v1.0 endpoint. Restrict the preview warning to the package-update and blocking calls; the installation paths and updated rollout dates are supported.

claims.claim: Agent2Agent-enabled Agent 365 agents can be used as connected agents in declarative agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft is introducing support for Microsoft Agent 365 agents that implement the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, allowing them to be used as connected agents in declarative agents built with Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.
